M1: appropriate non-adjacent placement expression. M1: $(7!/p!)\binom82$ or $(7!/p!){}^8P_2$, integer $p\ge1$; condone $2520\times28$. A1: 70560 exact; SC B1 70560 from M0,M1 only. Method 2: total with Rs fixed minus As together: $9!/(2!2!)-8!/2!=70560$. M1: $9!/(2!m!)-k$, $90720>k>1$, $m=1,2$. B1: $s-8!/2!$. M1: $9!/p-8!/q$, integers $p,q\ge1$; condone $90720-20160$. A1 exact; SC as above. Total: 4.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Method 1 scenarios: RRAL plus two of C,T,E,P,I gives $\binom52=10$; RRALL plus one gives $\binom51=5$; RRAAL plus one gives $\binom51=5$; RRAALL gives 1; total 21. M1: $\binom5x$ alone or times integer $k=1,2$, $0<x<5$, linked to an appropriate scenario. A1: $\binom52k$, $k=1$, or $\binom51m$, $m=1,2$, alone; if $\binom5x$ absent, SC B2 for 5 or 10 linked to correct scenario. M1: add outcomes from three or four identified correct scenarios only; equivalent product of combinations accepted. A1: 21, WWW, dependent only on second M. SC if not all/no scenarios: B1 for $10+5+5+1$, DB1 for 21. Method 2: fixing RRAL first, choose remaining two from seven: $\binom72=21$. M1: $\binom7x$ (or ${}^7P_x$) alone or times integer $k=1,2$, $0<x<7$. M1: $\binom72k$, $k=1,2$. A1: $\binom72$ only, no other terms. A1: 21. No other scenarios may appear in Method 2. Total: 4.
